description: This file contains the implementation of the GetCustomersQueryHandler class, which handles queries to retrieve a paginated list of customers based on search criteria. It utilizes repositories, specifications, AutoMapper, and MediatR to process the request and produce a response.

classes.name: GetCustomersQueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the GetCustomersQuery to retrieve a paginated list of customers, applying search and paging specifications, using the repository and AutoMapper for object transformation.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously handles the incoming GetCustomersQuery by fetching the relevant customer data, applying search and paging specifications, and returning a paginated response.
